h5Inferno3rdArchDemon.description:
Devils, Arch Devils and Arch Demons are the level 7 units of the Heroes V Inferno (merged into Inferno). All of them can teleport and have {Demonic} (-25% damage from Fire magic, +25% damage from Light magic). Arch Devils also have {Summon Pit Lord} (turns a demon corpse into Pit Lords, 1 time per battle, 2 times from experience level 7). Arch Demons also have {Teleport} (teleports one unit within range to its side).

Arch Demons are without doubt the leaders of the infernal hosts. These huge, savage monsters tower over the battlefield, and enemies fall to either side beneath their terrible weapons. Arch Demons can charge into the enemy ranks in an instant, and their immense strength lets them knock foes down with ease.

See also {Devil}, {Arch Devil}.

bonus.description:
{Steadfast Mind}
Immune to Mind spells

{Fire Ward}
Immune to harmful Fire spells

{Immune to Armageddon}
Unaffected by Armageddon

h5Inferno3rdFirebreatherHound.description:
Hell Hounds, Cerberi and Firehounds are the level 3 units of the Heroes V Inferno (merged into Inferno). All of them have {Demonic} (-25% damage from Fire magic, +25% damage from Light magic). Cerberi also have {No Enemy Retaliation} and {Three-Headed Attack} (attacks the enemies in the 3 hexes in front at once). Firehounds also have {Three-Headed Attack} (attacks the enemies in the 3 hexes in front at once), {No Enemy Retaliation} and {Fire Breath} (the attack also hits the unit behind the target).

Firehounds are not very strong, but they are extremely aggressive; their three heads constantly spew flames, striking fear into their enemies.

See also {Hell Hound}, {Cerberus}.

bonus.description:
{Fire Ward}
Immune to harmful Fire spells

h5Inferno3rdHellmare.description:
Hell Steeds, Nightmares and Hellmares are the level 5 units of the Heroes V Inferno (merged into Inferno). All of them have {Demonic} (-25% damage from Fire magic, +25% damage from Light magic) and {Fear Attack} (attacks have a chance to make the target flee and reset its ATB to 0). Nightmares also have {Aura of Fear} (-3 Morale for enemies within 3 hexes). Hellmares also have {Searing Aura} (adjacent enemies take 9 × the number of Hellmares in Fire damage before they act).

Hellfire, not blood, courses through the veins of the Hellmare. Heat surges from every part of its body, and anyone who dares come near is simply burned to a crisp.

See also {Hell Steed}, {Nightmare}.

bonus.description:
{Fire Ward}
Immune to harmful Fire spells

h5Inferno3rdHornedLeaper.description:
Horned Demons, Horned Overseers and Horned Grunts are the level 2 units of the Heroes V Inferno (merged into Inferno). All of them have {Demonic} (-25% damage from Fire magic, +25% damage from Light magic) and {Enrage} (Attack increases when an allied stack is destroyed). Horned Overseers also have {Explosion} (all adjacent units take Fire damage while it remains unharmed, 1 time per battle). Horned Grunts also have {Leap} (leaps 3–8 hexes to attack, +10% damage per hex, but takes 3 times the retaliation damage).

Horned Grunts hide on an island in the infernal sea of lava. They use their remarkable leaping power to pass through the scorching steam of the lava, looking for all the world as if they were taking a steam sauna. No creature can leap faster or farther than a Horned Grunt, a skill that has proven itself in real combat.

See also {Horned Demon}, {Horned Overseer}.

h5Inferno3rdPitSpawn.description:
Pit Fiends, Pit Lords and Pit Spawn are the level 6 units of the Heroes V Inferno (merged into Inferno). All of them have {Demonic} (-25% damage from Fire magic, +25% damage from Light magic). Pit Fiends can cast {Fireball Volley} and {Armor Break} (2 times per battle, 10 mana). Pit Lords can also cast {Fireball Volley}, {Meteor Shower} and {Armor Break} (4 times per battle, 20 mana), and have {Soul Stealer} (each attack or retaliation kills at least 1 enemy). Pit Spawn also have {Blade of Slaughter} (after an attack or retaliation, deals extra damage to the target equal to 2 × the number of creatures in the target stack) and {50% Magic Proof} (-50% magic damage).

The swords of the Pit Spawn are forged from extraordinarily resilient metal, which makes their attacks as quick and sharp as a viper's strike. In battle, Pit Spawn always try to kill more enemies with every swing.

See also {Pit Fiend}, {Pit Lord}.

bonus.description:
{Steadfast Mind}
Immune to Mind spells

h5Inferno3rdQuasit.description:
Devil Spawn, Imps and Vermin are the level 1 units of the Heroes V Inferno (merged into Inferno). All of them have {Demonic} (-25% damage from Fire magic, +25% damage from Light magic). Devil Spawn have {Spell Sabotage} (reduces the enemy hero's mana at the start of combat). Imps also have {Mana Stealer} (at the start of combat, steals mana from the enemy hero and gives it to the allied hero). Vermin also have {Siphon Mana} (drains enemy mana and gives it to allied spellcasting units, 1 time per battle).

These wretched little thieves steal whenever they get the chance. Their favorite loot is mana, which they hide in dark vials, ready at any moment to present to their masters in the hope of a rich reward.

See also {Devil Spawn}, {Imp}.

bonus.description:

Immune to harmful Fire spells

h5Inferno3rdSuccubusSeducer.description:
Succubi, Succubus Mistresses and Succubus Seducers are the level 4 units of the Heroes V Inferno (merged into Inferno). All of them can shoot and have {Demonic} (-25% damage from Fire magic, +25% damage from Light magic) and {Ranged Retaliation} (retaliates with a ranged attack when attacked at range). Succubus Mistresses also have {Chain Shot} (after the shot, it jumps to the nearest 3 enemies, with damage halved at each jump). Succubus Seducers also have {Immune to Puppet Master} and {Seduce} (takes control of an enemy stack for a number of rounds based on the Hit Points ratio, 1 time per battle).

Besides their fearsome looks, Succubus Seducers also have voices as sweet as honey. After hearing just a few words from one, anyone will hopelessly devote their strength to her.

See also {Succubus}, {Succubus Mistress}.

h5InfernoCerberius.description:
Hell Hounds, Cerberi and Firehounds are the level 3 units of the Heroes V Inferno (merged into Inferno). All of them have {Demonic} (-25% damage from Fire magic, +25% damage from Light magic). Cerberi also have {No Enemy Retaliation} and {Three-Headed Attack} (attacks the enemies in the 3 hexes in front at once). Firehounds also have {Three-Headed Attack} (attacks the enemies in the 3 hexes in front at once), {No Enemy Retaliation} and {Fire Breath} (the attack also hits the unit behind the target).

Their manic nature lets Cerberi move swiftly on the battlefield and launch furious, violent attacks on the enemy, but this excess of frenzy often makes them neglect their defense. Their attacks are hard to withstand, and their three heads let them damage several enemies at once.

See also {Hell Hound}, {Firehound}.

Horned Demons are slow-witted but strong low-ranking creatures of the infernal hosts. Their tough, hard-to-pierce hide lets them withstand a great many enemy attacks.

Nightmares come from the most twisted dreams of the people of Ashan. These creatures are wreathed in terror; when one attacks, even the bravest warriors grow weak with fright and can hardly raise a sword against it.
